_readme: Guest reviews shown on the Story and Visit pages. status: "sample" shows these placeholders with visible Sample tags (for preview only, never publish them as genuine); "hidden" leaves the section out entirely, so the pages can go live before real reviews arrive; "live" shows real reviews. To go live: paste real Google reviews (name as shown on Google, rating, text, month), set rating/count from the Google listing, set status to "live", then run npm run build.

reviews.text: The Gourd-Gée tiramisu is worth the trip on its own. Watching the espresso poured at the table made it feel like an occasion.
